TextEng: The fabled 'Hunter-of-Men' is a sure-footed predator of the North. More than just a simple bobcat, however, it wields some magical properties as well.
Text: 전설적인 '인간 사냥꾼'은 확실한 북쪽의 포식자입니다. 그러나 단순한 스라소니와 달리 약간의 마법적 속성도 가지고 있습니다다.

TextEng: An Accursed One is a svirfneblin cultist who enslaves his own people. Though his kin must follow his orders, the Accursed Ones are hated even more than the cultists he works for.
This is one of the High Priestesses of the cultists in Undermountain.
This is an evil dwarven cultist who has traded his soul for the ability to steal the souls of others. He then devours those souls, sustaining his life for eternity.
A Dark Prelate is a powerful drow mage who has authority over most males and even a few females.
This is a cultist leader and a cruel foe.

Dryads are exquisitely beautiful tree sprites found deep in secluded woodlands. They sometimes aid adventurers and can prove a source of useful information. Lords of the dark fey, the Unseelie rule the night and are some of the only creatures who can actually command the Fey.
Text: 드라이어드는 외딴 삼림지대 깊은 곳에서 발견되는 매우 아름다운 나무의 요정입니다. 그들은 때때로 모험가들을 돕고 유용한 정보를 제공합니다.

TextEng: The Lighteaters are elite drow warriors and assassins who are sent to destroy specific targets on the surface, such as elven strongholds.

Corpses reanimated through necromancy, most Zombies are mindless undead that shamble about, trying to satiate the dull ache of hunger in their decaying gut. Some, however, have been animated for a purpose which requires some semblance of intelligence.
Demiliches are wiser, older and far deadlier than common liches.

With perfect builds and flawless skin, Succubi are the most comely of demons. They live to tempt mortal men into crimes of passion. Arch Minions have risen in the ranks of demonkind and rule ruthlessly over their lessers.
Text: 완벽한 체격에 흠잡을 데 없는 피부를 가진 서큐버스는 악마 중 가장 흔합니다. 그들은 필멸자 남성을 욕정의 죄악으로 유도합니다.

TextEng: Bony, vulture-like creatures, Vrocks are the foot soldiers of the Abyss. Notoriously vain, they prance about in battle, admiring their sharp claws and beaks. Vile Contenders have risen in the ranks of fiendkind and rule ruthlessly over their lessers.
Text: 뼈가 드러난 독수리 같은 생명체인 브록은 심연의 보병입니다. 허영심이 강한 것으로 악명높은 이들은 날카로운 발톱과 부리를 뽐내며 전장을 누빕니다.

TextEng: Unlike other devils, erinyes appear attractive to humans, resembling very comely women except for their huge feathery wings and sinister eyes. Fell Lieutenants have risen in the ranks of devilkind and rule ruthlessly over their lessers.

Pit fiends are the undisputed leaders of the baatezu. They are large and powerful humanoids with nasty fangs that drip with a vile green liquid. High fiends have risen in the ranks of devilkind and rule ruthlessly over their lessers.
Text: 나락의 마귀는 논란의 여지가 없는 바테주의 지도자입니다. 역겨운 녹색 액체가 방울방울 떨어지는 더러운 송곳니를 가진 크고 강력한 인간형 생명체 입니다.

TextEng: With their flaming wings and skull-like countenance, these demons are among the greatest and most feared of their kind. Fell Masters have risen in the ranks of demonkind and rule ruthlessly over their lessers.
Text: 불타는 날개와 해골 같은 얼굴을 가진 이 악마는 악마들 중에 가장 위대하며 가장 두려운 존재입니다.

TextEng: While most wyrmlings are rather fragile, a Paragon Wyrmling is larger and healthier, usually surviving longer than its brethren. Some of the largest and most powerful dragons began as Paragons.

Shadow dragons are sly, devious creatures with ties to the Plane of Shadows. Shadow dragons have translucent scales and dark bodies, giving them an indistinct appearance - from a distance they seem to be nothing but a foreboding mass of shadows.

A chaotic offshoot of the pseudodragon, the faerie dragon lives in peaceful, tangled forests and thrives on pranks, mischief and practical jokes.  Faerie dragons resemble miniature dragons with gossamer butterfly wings.  Although they are generally well-meaning, most adventurers are advised to be wary of their sense of humor.
The drow are an evil subrace of elves, living deep underground in the dangerous Underdark.

The bones of the dead, animated by dark magic, Skeletons have no mind of their own. They are but an extension of their master's will. Forgotten Warriors have more power in death than common skeletons do.

TextEng: Created by demented wizards, Bone Golems are generally used to guard prized possessions. Their bodies are pieced together from various creatures, both humanoid and monster. A Bone Lord is simply a tougher, more deadly version of a Bone Golem.

Corpses reanimated through necromancy, Zombies are mindless undead that shamble about, trying to satiate the dull ache of hunger in their decaying gut. Rotten servants, because good help is so hard to find.

TextEng: Corpses reanimated through necromancy, Zombies are mindless undead that shamble about, trying to satiate the dull ache of hunger in their decaying gut. Rotten Masters are zombies that have more powerful enchantments placed upon their bodies, making them more durable than a normal zombie.

TextEng: Ritually preserved and animated corpses that maintain their timeless vigil over tombs and temple complexes, Mummies are an effective deterrent to would-be grave-robbers. A Forsaken Pharoah was a despotic ruler in life who commands greater power than a regular mummy in death.
Text: 의식에 따라 보존되었으며 되살아난 시체인, 무덤과 사원을 끝없이 지키고 있는 미라는 무덤 도굴꾼들에게 효과적인 억제책입니다.

TextEng: More deadly and cunning than their lesser kin, the Ghoul, these undead carrion eaters have the added ability to paralyze their victims. He Who Hungers is even more deadly than a regular ghast.
Text: 그들의 하급 친척인 구울보다 더 치명적이고 교활하며, 이 썩은 고기를 먹는 언데드는 희생자를 마비시키는 추가적인 능력을 가지고 있습니다.

TextEng: A formian resembles a strange, centaur-like creature with the body and head of a giant ant, but with humanoid forelimbs. Their bodies are encased in a brownish-red, black or white carapace. They are not cruel, but live in a strict, regimented society.
Text: 포르미안은 거대한 개미의 몸과 머리를 가진 켄타우로스 같은 이상한 생명체를 닮았지만, 앞다리는 인간형입니다. 몸은 적갈색, 검은색 또는 흰색 갑각으로 덮여 있습니다. 잔인하지는 않지만 엄격하고 규율 잡힌 사회에서 삽니다. 포르미안 일꾼은 가장 낮은 계급이자 가장 흔한 포르미안입니다. 오직 봉사하기 위해 존재하며, 벌집에 필요한 모든 필수적이고 하찮은 일을 수행합니다. 서투른 발톱은 육체 노동에만 적합합니다.

TextEng: These brutish cave dwellers live communally and some have a basic grasp of magic. Intensely protective of their kin, they are generally reluctant to trust outsiders. A Smasher is the leader of a tribe of Mountain Giants.
Text: 이 잔인한 동굴 거주자는 공동생활을 하며 몇몇은 마법을 기본적으로 이해합니다. 친족을 극심하게 보호하고, 일반적으로 외지인을 믿지 않습니다.

TextEng: Ettins, or two-headed giants, are vicious and unpredictable hunters that stalk the night. Their two heads make them exceptionally sharp-eyed and alert. A Basher is an older, more powerful ettin.
Text: 두 개의 머리를 가진 거인인 에틴은 사악하고 예측이 불가능한 사냥꾼이자 한밤의 추적자입니다. 두 개의 머리 덕택에 특출나게 날카로운 눈을 가졌으며, 빈틈없는 경계를 펼칩니다.

TextEng: Frost giants are justifiably feared as brutal and wantonly destructive raiders. They have the appearance of oversized, muscular humans with snow-white or ivory skin. A Warden is a powerful guardian of a frost giant tribe.
Text: 서리 거인은 잔혹하고 제멋데로 파괴하는 침략자이기 때문에 두려움의 대상입니다. 이들은 눈처럼 희거나 상아색 피부를 가진 거대하고 근육질 인간의 외형을 가지고 있습니다.

TextEng: Ogres are ugly, greedy creatures who live by raiding and scavenging. They associate freely with Giants and Trolls, banding together to prey on the weak. Widowguards are the elite warriors of the ogres.
Text: 오우거는 약탈과 쓰레기를 뒤지며 살아가는 못생기고 탐욕스러운 생명체 입니다. 이들은 거인, 트롤과 자유롭게 어울리며, 약한 사람들을 먹이감으로 삼기 위해 뭉칩니다.

TextEng: Svirfneblin or deep gnomes are reclusive, suspicious and resentful of intrusion.

Weapons and armor made from adamantium are far tougher than their steel brethren. Take the toughness of a steel golem and multiply that by a factor of all that is unholy and you get the rough idea of what you face here.

The first known creation of this type was by a powerful devil, Maligothez, who stripped the flesh from an enemy demon, Llargash. Maligothez bound his rival's flesh to the bones of a troll and then animated them, creating a powerful construct of pure malevolence. Although Maligothez was eventually destroyed by rival devils, his creation survived his death and killed most of its master's attackers with a ferocity that impressed all devil-kin. The creation of other, similar constructs has become something akin to a sport on certain levels of hell.
A mithril golem is capable of quick and lethal action, making it one of the most powerful of golems.

Helmed Horrors are suits of empty armor imbued with magical life and purpose. They make tireless and extremely effective guardians, soldiers, and bounty hunters.
These insects seem organized and efficient. They also aggressively protect their territory.

Orcs are aggressive humanoids that raid, pillage, and battle other creatures. They have a hatred of elves and dwarves that goes back many generations. The Mud Tribe elders are the rulers over a large number of orcs.
Text: 오크는 다른 생명체들을 습격하고, 약탈하고, 싸우는 공격적인 인간형 생명체입니다. 그들은 엘프와 드워프에 대해 몇 세대에 걸친 증오심을 가지고 있습니다.

TextEng: While Goblins are often considered little more than a nuisance, an unchecked population can often balloon into a serious threat to normally civilized areas. The Elders of the Rat Tribe are skilled and cunning warriors, easily dominating their goblin cousins.
Text: 고블린은 보통 성가신 존재에 불과하지만, 인구를 억제하지 않으면 종종 부풀어 올라 문명화된 지역에 심각한 위협이 될 수 있습니다.

TextEng: Gnolls are every bit like the hyena they resemble; Cruel and vicious. Dog Tribe Elders are the most cruel and vicious, using the nastiest tricks to keep their kin in line.
Text: 놀은 그들과 모습이 닮은 하이에나와 매우 흡사하게 잔인하고 악랄합니다.

TextEng: Troglodytes are cave-dwelling reptilian humanoids who take pleasure in fighting battles and in eating the bodies of their dead foes. While not very bright, trogs are known for their ferocity, cunning, and horrific stench. The Rib Tribe Elders are known for their ferocity and cunning in battle.
Text: 동굴인은 동굴에 사는 인간형 파충류 생명체로써 전투를 즐기고 죽은 적의 시체를 먹는 것을 즐깁니다. 똑똑하지는 않지만, 흉포함과 교활함 그리고 끔찍한 악취로 유명합니다.

TextEng: The biggest and strongest of the goblinoids, Bugbears receive their name from their bear-like noses, strong upper body, and keen sense of smell. A Bone Tribe Elder is an elite guard of the bugbears.
Text: 고블린형 생명체 중 가장 크고 힘이 센 버그베어는 곰처럼 생긴 코와 튼튼한 상체, 예민한 후각에서 이름을 따왔습니다.

TextEng: Hive Workers seem organized and efficient. Their ability to hurl balls of acid across a distance also makes them potent defenders.
With their chitinous, seemingly metallic shell, Hive Warriors are hard to kill. More dangerous, however, are the sharpened, blade-like appendages that they wield in defense of their territory.

Hive defenders are able to lob balls of digestive acid over considerable distances. These giant beetles feed primarily on carrion and offal.
Consorts to the Hive Mother, these creatures have two jobs: to fertilize the eggs and to defend the Hive Mother.
Returned to vigor by evil sorcerers, these undead Intellect Devourers are more resilient and have greater mental acuity than their still-living brethren.

Primitive and savage, these reptilian humanoids can be very dangerous if provoked. They are fiercely territorial, banding together to protect the swamplands they inhabit. Meelok Hierophants are the elite warrior kings of certain lizardfolk tribes.
Text: 원시적이고 야만적인 이 파충류 인간형 생명체를 도발한다면 매우 위험할 수 있습니다. 이들은 사나울 정도로 영역 지향적이며, 서식하는 습지대를 보호하기 위해 무리를 짓습니다.

TextEng: In their hybrid form, Wererats are secretive and untrustworthy. They make excellent thieves and spies, however -- if you're willing to risk being double-crossed. The Nobles - including Barons, Contessas, Duchesses, Earls and Marquis - are a group of shapechangers who have set themselves up as a council of rulers over all lycanthropes.
Text: 혼합된 형상을 가진, 시궁쥐인간은 비밀스럽고 믿을 수 없습니다. 하지만 그들은 훌륭한 도둑과 첩자일 수 있습니다. 만약 당신이 이중첩자에 대한 위험을 감수한다면 말이죠.

TextEng: In their hybrid form, Werecats are selfish and manipulative. They have been known to toy with and enslave their prey, often driving them to madness. The Nobles - including Barons, Contessas, Duchesses, Earls and Marquis - are a group of shapechangers who have set themselves up as a council of rulers over all lycanthropes.
Text: 혼합된 형상을 가진, 고양이인간은 이기적이고 교활합니다. 이들은 먹잇감을 가지고 장난치고 노예로 삼는 것으로 알려져 있으며, 종종 자신을 광기로 몰아넣습니다.

TextEng: The most common of the lycanthropes, Werewolves are also the most complex, socially. While some lead solitary existences, others form complicated ritual-bound societies. The Nobles - including Barons, Contessas, Duchesses, Earls and Marquis - are a group of shapechangers who have set themselves up as a council of rulers over all lycanthropes.
Text: 가장 흔한 야수인간인 늑대인간은 사회적인 면에서 가장 복잡합니다. 어떤 이들은 고독한 삶을 영위하지만, 어떤 이들은 복잡한 의식에 얽매인 사회를 형성합니다.

TextEng: While not true undead, these ghoulish constructs are crafted from collections of stolen human body parts, stitched together into single composite form. A Forgotten Servant is an even more powerful version of this type of golem.
Text: 사실 언데드는 아니지만, 이 구울 같은 구조물은 인간의 신체 부위를 훔쳐 모아 하나의 형태로 엮어 만든 합성물입니다.

TextEng: Master mages use Enchanted Servants as guardians of their realms.

Weapons and armor made from adamantium are far tougher than their steel brethren. Take the toughness of a steel golem and multiply that by a factor of all that is unholy and you get the rough idea of what you face here. A Favored Servant is an even more powerful version of this type of golem.
Forged from wizard's steel and imbued with raging spirits, Minogons are dangerous foes indeed. Their savage cries have left many of their victims stunned.

At the same time both savage and maternal, the Primordial Render is a deadly predator that often protects weaker creatures within its habitat. It is far more powerful than the more common Grey Renders.

A manticore is a monster in every sense of the word.  It has the head of a vaguely humanoid beast, the body of a lion and the wings of a dragon.  The creature's back is set with curved barbs, and its long tail ends in a cluster of vicious spikes, which it can hurl to deadly effect. A Paragon is simply a larger, deadlier manticore.
Text: 만티코어는 그야말로 괴물입니다. 어렴풋이 인간을 닮은 짐승의 머리, 사자의 몸통, 용의 날개를 지녔습니다. 등에는 휜 가시가 돋아 있고, 긴 꼬리 끝에는 날카로운 가시 다발이 달려 있어 적에게 던질 수 있습니다.

TextEng: Brass Dragons are talkative gossipmongers. They may have useful information, but usually share it only after long rambling and hinting for a gift.
Bronze Dragons are inquisitive and enjoy polymorphing into animals to better observe adventurers. Fascinated by warfare, they'll eagerly join a just cause... for good pay.
Copper Dragons are incorrigible pranksters, joke tellers, and riddlers. Most are good-natured but also have a covetous, miserly streak.
Gold Dragons are graceful, sinuous, and wise. They hate injustice and foul play, often embarking on self-appointed quests to promote good.
Prismatic dragons are flamboyant, personable and charming. They avoid confrontation, fighting only if attacked.

Silver Dragons are regal and statuesque. They cheerfully assist good creatures in genuine need, often taking human or elven form to maintain their anonymity.
Pseudodragons resemble miniature red dragons, but are red-brown in color rather than deep red.  They have fine scales and sharp horns and teeth.  Their barbed, venomous tails are a favored weapon.
Returned to vigor by evil sorcerers, these undead Intellect Devourers are more resilient and have greater mental acuity than their still-living brethren.
The bones of the dead, animated by dark magic, Skeletons have no mind of their own. This skeleton has been granted the spark of intelligence in order to command others of its kind.
Text: 죽은 이의 뼈를 어둠의 마법으로 되살려낸, 해골은 마음을 가지고 있지 않습니다. 단지 주인의 의지에 따를 뿐입니다.

TextEng: A Consort is a high ranking drow female who follows Lolth.
A Mistress is a title for a drow female who teaches young female drow how to rule a household.
A Governess is a high ranking position amongst the noble houses of the drow.
The Matrons are the heads of the drow houses. They tend to be those who are the most cunning and cruel.
The Matriarchs are the heads of Drow Society. They tend to be those who are the most cunning and cruel.

Black dragons are evil-tempered, cunning and malevolent, characteristics that are reflected in their crafty, sinister faces.  Even at a young age, they are already dangerous.  The wyrmling's scales are thin, small, and glossy.

Wyrmling blue dragons have scales of iridescent azure and lack the large horn that grows on their snout as they age.  Their wings beat with quick energy and tend to hum and crackle faintly with built-up static electricity.

Brass dragons are talkative, although as wyrmlings they may have some initial shyness.  Like older brass dragons, they love presents and long chats when they can get them.  Their scales are a dull, mottled brown at birth, and grow more warm and burnished with age.  Brass dragons love intense, dry heat and spend most of their time basking in the desert sun.  They are accompanied by a tangy metallic or sandy odor.

Bronze dragons are inquisitive even as wyrmlings, and will frequently spy on adventuring parties for fun.  A bronze wyrmling's scales are tinged with green, showing only a hint of bronze.  They are fascinated by warfare, although they are cautious enough to avoid getting too close to battlefields when young and vulnerable.

Copper dragons are incorrigible pranksters, joke tellers and riddlers.  Most are good-natured but also have a covetous, miserly streak.  They are powerful jumpers and climbers, with strong thighs and shoulders.  At birth, a copper dragon's scales have a ruddy brown color with a metallic tint.

Gold dragons are graceful and sinuous.  They hate injustice and foul play, and will do what they can to right wrongs even at a young age.  On hatching, a gold dragon's scales are dark yellow with golden metallic flecks.  They smell faintly of saffron and incense.
Green dragons are belligerent and tend to attack without provocation, although as wyrmlings they are more cautious.  A wyrmling green dragon's scales are thin, very small and a deep shade of green.

Red dragons are the most covetous of all dragons, even as wyrmlings, though their opportunities for gathering treasure are more limited, making them even more greedy when the chance presents itself.  The small scales of wymlings are a bright glossy scarlet, making them easily spotted by predators and hunters, so they generally stay underground and do not venture outside until they are more able to take care of themselves.  Toward the end of their young stage the scales turn a deeper red and the glossy texture is replaced by a smooth, dull finish.

Silver dragons are cheerful and good-natured, and are inclined to help worthy mortals.  A silver wyrmling's scales are blue-gray with silver highlights.  As the dragon approaches adulthood, its color slowly brightens until the individual scales are scarcely visible.  From a distance, these dragons look as if they have been sculpted from pure metal.  A faint smell of rain always accompanies them.

Among the smallest and least intelligent of dragonkind, most white dragons are simply animalistic predators, the young in particular.  The scales of a wyrmling white dragon glisten like mirrors, and it is marked by a crisp, faintly chemical odor.
